draft_text: Under matched inference conditions, Velora uses less peak GPU memory than Dravik, at 9.6 versus 14.8 GiB.
revised_text: Under matched inference conditions, Velora's directly measured peak GPU memory was 9.6 GiB; Dravik's peak GPU memory was not measured, though its larger parameter count (2.4B vs 1.3B) provides directional, indirect evidence of higher model-weight memory.
rationale: Dravik's peak GPU memory was not measured (T1.r2.mem = "Not measured"); only Velora's 9.6 GiB is a direct measurement. The 14.8 GiB figure for Dravik is unsupported. The parameter-count difference (1.3 vs 2.4B) is only directional, indirect evidence. No statistical test was reported.
